name: pokevoxel
description: An unofficial local-ROM browser fork integrating Gen1Recomp with Dramatic Shape Voxel Mod.

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run typecheck && npm run build:client && npm run audit:dist
scripts.verify: npm run verify:upstream && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:lua && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:client && npm run audit:dist && POKEVOXEL_SKIP_CLIENT_BUILD=1 npm run test:browser
scripts.verify:private: npm run verify && POKEVOXEL_SKIP_RUNTIME_BUILD=1 POKEVOXEL_SKIP_CLIENT_BUILD=1 npm run test:browser:audio:focused && npm run test:native-audio
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/run-browser-lane.mjs -- tests/browser/welcome.spec.ts tests/browser/rom-rejection.spec.ts tests/browser/import-and-boot.spec.ts tests/browser/privateRomAudit.spec.ts tests/browser/save-persistence.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:full: npm run build:runtime && npm run audit:runtime && npm run build:client && npm run audit:dist && POKEVOXEL_SKIP_CLIENT_BUILD=1 npm run test:browser && POKEVOXEL_SKIP_RUNTIME_BUILD=1 POKEVOXEL_SKIP_CLIENT_BUILD=1 npm run test:browser:audio:focused && POKEVOXEL_SKIP_CLIENT_BUILD=1 npm run test:browser:audio:journey
